name: SHINE Student Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You help out at the hospital. The hospital calls this work hospitality tasks.
who_can_apply: High school and college students who are 16 or older. You need a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher.
pay_detail: Volunteer. The program page does not list pay or service hours.
deadline_text: The page header says volunteering is on hold for now. No dates or deadline are given.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Add one letter from a counselor, teacher, principal or coach. Add your latest school transcript. Write an essay of at least 500 words about you and why volunteering matters.
notes: The page header says Temporarily Suspended, but the SHINE section still lists the steps. Call 510-264-4139 to ask when volunteering restarts. Leave your name, phone number and question. The program page does not give hours per week.
